_readme: Copy this file to <code>.lang.json (e.g. de.lang.json), set code and name, translate the values on the right. Leave a line out or unchanged to keep English. Keep {placeholders} as they are. Optional: aliases = your own names for functions, step_words = your word for 'step', help = list of help-text lines.
name: Your language name

strings.Name: Name
strings.Variable(s) to read from the keyboard.\n:
Variable(s) to read from the keyboard.
Examples:   n      a, b      A[i]
strings.What to print - text in quotes, variable:
What to print - text in quotes, variables without.
Example:   "Total =", total
strings.Statements, one per line (or separated b:
Statements, one per line (or separated by ;).
Examples:   total = total + i      A = array(5)      A[0] = 7
strings.Loop definition:\n i = 1 to n i =:
Loop definition:
  i = 1 to n      i = 10 to 1 step -1      x in A
Enter one or more variable names, e.g.   n   or   a, b   or   A[i]
strings.Write at least one statement, e.g. x =: Write at least one statement, e.g.   x = 1
strings.Loop format: i = 1 to n or i = 1 t: Loop format:   i = 1 to n   or   i = 1 to n step 2   or   x in A
strings.'{name}' is not supported here (use arro: '{name}' is not supported here (use arrows, Decision and Loop blocks for if/loops)
strings.names may not start with an underscore: names may not start with an underscore
strings.only built-in helpers can be called (abs: only built-in helpers can be called (abs, sqrt, round, int, len, array, randint, ...)
strings.array(...) needs non-negative whole-numb: array(...) needs non-negative whole-number sizes, e.g. array(5) or array(3, 4)
The chart needs exactly one Start block.
strings.'{name}' has no value yet - give it a va: '{name}' has no value yet - give it a value first
strings.Array index out of range (indexes start: Array index out of range (indexes start at 0)
strings.This value can't be looped over: This value can't be looped over
strings.Drag blocks to move | double-click to: Drag blocks to move  |  double-click to edit  |  right-drag from one block to another to connect  |  Delete removes
strings.Click the first block, then the block it: Click the first block, then the block it should lead to.
strings.Click on the canvas to place a {name} bl: Click on the canvas to place a {name} block.
Now click the block it should lead to.
strings.Example loaded - press F5 to run it; Fil: Example loaded - press F5 to run it; File > New for a blank chart.
strings.New chart. Pick a block on the left, the: New chart. Pick a block on the left, then click on the canvas.
Press Step to run the orange block.
strings.The run stopped because of an error (the: The run stopped because of an error (the red block).
A block can't point to itself.
An End block can't have outgoing arrows.
strings.A decision already has its Yes and No ar: A decision already has its Yes and No arrows.
strings.A loop already has its Loop and Done arr: A loop already has its Loop and Done arrows.
There is already a Start block.
That file isn't a valid flowchart.
strings.Save changes to the current flowchart fi: Save changes to the current flowchart first?
strings.Connector name, e.g. A\nTwo connectors:
Connector name, e.g.   A
Two connectors with the same name are linked: the flow jumps from the one with no outgoing arrow to the one that has an arrow.
Leave it empty for a plain junction.
strings.An End-loop block must be wired back to: An End-loop block must be wired back to a Loop block.
strings.Connector '{name}' has no partner (you n: Connector '{name}' has no partner (you need a connector with the same name that has an outgoing arrow).
strings.An End-loop block can only be wired to a: An End-loop block can only be wired to a Loop block.
strings.Wire selected - Delete removes it; drag: Wire selected - Delete removes it; drag the middle handle to add a bend point; right-click for a menu.
strings.Select a row and press Change (or double: Select a row and press Change (or double-click), then press the new key combination.
strings.{key} is already used for \"{other}\". A: {key} is already used for "{other}". Assign it here anyway?
strings.Press the new key combination for \"{nam: Press the new key combination for "{name}"
strings.Language files are small .lang.json file:
Language files are small .lang.json files. Download one and put it in any of these folders, then restart the program:

{dirs}
